notes.title: 🩸 Nocturnal Visitors arrives on Steam! 🩸
notes.notes:
We're very happy to announce that Nocturnal Visitors has been released on Steam today!

Nocturnal Visitors is an adventure and horror game where you investigate crimes scenes and look for clues!

Play as Jamie and five other characters with unique personalities, backgrounds and points of view.

Enjoy the game now with 20% launch discount!
